clauses.text: In no event shall either party's aggregate liability exceed the total fees paid under this Agreement in the twelve months preceding the claim.
Each party's aggregate liability shall be capped at two times the fees paid in the prior twelve months.
Liability is limited to direct damages; neither party is liable for indirect or consequential damages.
Each party shall keep the other's Confidential Information secret and use it solely to perform this Agreement, for three years after disclosure.
The receiving party shall protect Confidential Information with the same care it uses for its own, for two years after disclosure.
This Agreement is governed by the laws of India and the courts of Bengaluru have exclusive jurisdiction.
Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience on thirty days' written notice.
Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience on sixty days' written notice.
